From Tonasket, cross the Okanogan River and drive west on Loomis-Oroville Road to Loomis.

From Stevens Pass, drive US-2 east 11.3 miles and turn north onto FR-657, signed for Merritt Lake. Follow it 1.6 miles to the road's end and trailhead parking.

Four Brothers sits on Chikamin Ridge in the Alpine Lakes Wilderness, and the standard approach starts at the Mineral Creek Trailhead (Trail #1331, ~2,375 ft), reached via SR 903 north from Cle Elum ~17 mi, then Cooper Lake Rd/FR-46 roughly 9-10 mi to the signed trailhead.

North from Cle Elum via Highway 903 (about 17 miles, past Lake Cle Elum), then left on Cooper Lake Road (FR-4600) approximately 10 miles, over Cooper Pass and down to the trailhead at the road's end in the valley bottom
Trailhead: Mineral Creek Trailhead (Trail #1331), roughly 2,360-2,400 ft, reached via FR-4600 over Cooper Pass.

From Cle Elum, drive SR-903 north 17 miles past Lake Cle Elum and turn left onto Road 4600 (Cooper Lake Road). Drive Road 4600 about 7 miles over Cooper Pass, then stay on Road 4600 about 3 miles down to the small signed trailhead.

From I-90 take Exit 32, turn left onto 436th Ave SE and follow it to SE North Bend Way; turn left, then after 0.3 mile turn right onto SE Mount Si Road and continue 2.4 miles to the trailhead entrance on the left.

From the Narada Falls parking lot on the road to Paradise, plowed year-round, climb the steep hillside about 200 ft to Stevens Canyon Road; when that road is open, roughly late May to mid-October, most parties park at the Reflection Lake pullout instead and skip the climb
From the Nisqually entrance of Mount Rainier National Park, drive east on Paradise Road about 14 miles; the signed Narada Falls parking lot is on the right, about 1 mile before the Paradise area.
